title: ORN Ventures plans over ₹10,000 crore global investment in five years
description:
Tech-driven travel firm ORN Ventures plans to invest upwards of Rs 10,000 crore globally over the next five years to expand its travel infrastructure, strengthen its distribution network and set up experience hubs across key markets.
In an interview with PTI, ORN Ventures Founder & CEO Vinay Gupta shared that the company is looking to deepen its presence in international markets as it scales its direct operator-to-consumer travel platform.
"We will be investing north of 10,000 crore globally," he said, confirming that the investment plan was over the next five years," he said and indicated that the deployment could be completed much earlier, "I think we if you ask me it'll be in less than 24 months," he noted.
Gupta said the investment would be funded through a combination of the company's cash flows and fundraising.
